name: Tree, ground level
description: On a synthetic test tree these cards looked worse than the default crossed cards from oblique and ground-level views; check on your own trees. 2 crossed cards plus 2 horizontal crown slices, one 512 px picture set per tree. Colour bleeds into every transparent texel, so leaf edges stay clean in the distance (padding full). Leaf area is kept in the smaller mipmaps; coverage mips only take effect with .dds output.
select_hint: Select the trees or bushes, or only their foliage to keep a real trunk. Compare with the default crossed cards on your own trees first.
